name: Colossal Crisis
detailed_description:
Can a lone swordsman stand against giants?

A once-thriving island now lies in ruins. Towering giants, led by the tyrannical Master Giant, have brought the land to its knees. In this fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer, you are the island’s last hope, a lone swordsman with nothing but your blade, your will, and the resolve to bring down the colossals who shattered your world.

Precision Hack-and-Slash Combat

Master a tight and responsive combat system that rewards skill, timing, and strategy. Chain together sword strikes and dodge through deadly attacks in fluid, fast-paced battles.

Conquer 7 Action-Packed Levels

Battle your way through a journey across diverse environments, from shattered villages and stormy skies to the gates of a ruined castle in the land of the giants, Humungo. Each level brings new enemies, platforming challenges, and a path deeper into the giants' domain.

Face the Colossals

Two towering titans stand in your way: the brutal Earth Giant, and the ultimate force behind the island’s downfall—the Master Giant. These boss battles are intense, cinematic showdowns where only precise movement and brutal counters will carry you to victory.

Save What Remains

The war against the giants has already devastated the island. Now, with only fragments of hope left, you must face overwhelming odds, reclaim the land, and put an end to the chaos once and for all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8400 or AMD Athlon 200GE
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 14.0 (Sonoma)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or Apple M1
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics or better
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD Phenom II X4 965
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.0+ compatible GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
